name: Platan u kostela sv. Klimenta (Nove Mlyny)
verify_notes: Pamatny strom, 342 cm in 2017, on the corner of Nove Mlyny and Klimentska opposite the church of St Clement, on a public street. It stands 250 metres from the Rasnovka oak (prg_016), so the two make a genuine two-tree pocket in the Petrska quarter and it would be the cheapest possible eleventh tree. Failed on the count and on repetition: the page already carries four London planes and a fifth adds a species, not a reason to walk. Its register note claims nothing beyond being a local dominant of above average size and age, so it needs a story before it needs a pin.
